huntBeats.text: A woman, maybe 60s spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
💡 Burdock. The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
👁 It hears you coming mid-wingbeat — in the air, you don't catch it. Hunt it roosting at dawn, or wait for the water it must come down to.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
✨ Ability gained: Lucky Rock (L1). Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)
📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
1. Trial of the Long Stalk — Take game with patience, not noise.
📺 TRIAL ACCEPTED: Trial of the Long Stalk. "Excellent choice. We simulated all three. This one had the best lighting."
🏹 TRIUMPH: you read the ground like a letter — bent grass, a print, the wind in your face. The kill is clean, quick, and kind. The System replays it eleven times.
(The village feasts tonight: +600 kcal to the pantry. The watchers will remember the stalk.)
"Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."

Yuki leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about ducks in a row. Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces."
